concepts.def: Servicemen's Readjustment Act provided returning veterans with college tuition, mortgages and unemployment pay; created suburban middle class.
Senator Joseph McCarthy's 1950-54 anti-communist witch hunts; HUAC investigations, Hollywood blacklist, fall of State Department officials.
Johnson's reforms: Medicare, Medicaid, Voting Rights Act, immigration reform, War on Poverty.
28 June police raid on Greenwich Village gay bar sparked riots; catalyst for gay liberation movement.
Supreme Court 7-2 ruling that constitutional right to privacy covered abortion; landmark of second-wave feminism.
Nixon's cover-up of DNC headquarters break-in; impeachment proceedings forced resignation on 9 August 1974.
